comment: Kenney asset manifest (SPEC2 M12 stage 0 + M13 bundle 1; E-14/D-140/
D-160/D-169). Pure text: pack URLs + SHA-256 pins for `npm run
assets:fetch`, and the model-to-game mapping `npm run assets:bake`
rasterises. The zip URLs embed a CMS media hash, so a Kenney re-upload
changes URL AND checksum together - re-pin both from the pack page when
a fetch 404s.
Mapping targets: `vehicle:<catalogId>` (8 facings),
`building:<zone>:<stage>[:<variant>]`, `industry:<TypeName>` and
`tree:<climate>:<n>` (1 facing each; climates temperate/arctic/tropical/
desert after MapClimate). `scale` is model units to metres - an art
choice per entry (vehicles ride ~1.7x over their catalogue lengthM so
they read at 64 px/tile, the TTD convention).
M13 completes the catalogue: every rail, road and water catalogue entry
is mapped; a coupling test in tests/unit/assetsBake.spec.ts holds this
file against the catalogues in both directions.
Company-colour zones (`tint`): `materials` lists glTF material names
(the older kits, e.g. Nature Kit, carry named materials);
`hues` marks every face whose resolved colour falls in a hue band,
because the colormap kits paint a livery as a RAMP of shades around one
hue inside a single "colormap" material; `colors` pins exact #rrggbb
patches. The bake renders zone faces neutral grey in the base cell and
writes a mask cell whose grey value carries the NW shading - tinting
the mask with a company colour multiplies to a shaded livery.
Reused-model variants (D-169): `recolor` {hueShift deg, saturation x,
value x} deterministically recolours the NON-tint hull faces, and
`stretch` [x, y, z] scales per model axis around the ground pivot (+z is
the travel axis). Every reuse carries a `note` naming the gap it fills;
the full register is the D-169 entry.
Gaps that stay procedural per E-14: aircraft (no Kenney 3D aircraft
kit), the coal-mine headframe and oil derrick, the Farm (no farmstead
model in any pinned kit), and every dev build without a cache. The
watercraft ship-large galleon and the Pirate Kit ships stay filed for
the pre-1920 eras (M23) - no current catalogue entry predates 1950.
credits: All 3D models by Kenney (kenney.nl), CC0. Credited in README and the credits screen although CC0 requires none.
